ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْفَقْرِ إِلَّا إِلَيْكَ ، وَ مِنَ الذُّلِّ إِلَّا لَكَ، وَمِنَ الْخَوْفِ إِلَّا مِنْكَ ، وَ أَعُوْذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَقُوْلَ زُوْرًا أَوْ أَغْشَى فُجُوْرًا أَوْ أَكُوْنَ بِكَ مَغْرُوْرًا .
tr: Allāhumma innī a`ūdhu bi ka mina ‘l-faqri illā ilayka, Wa mina ‘dh-dhulli illā laka, Wa min ‘l-khawfi illa min ka, Wa a`ūdhu bi ka an aqūla zūran aw aghshā fujūran aw akūna bi ka maghrūrā.
en: O Allah, I surely seek refuge with you from need except for You, from humility except for You, and from fear except of You! I seek refuge with You lest I speak falsehood or commit immorality or be deluded about You!

ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْفِتَنِ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ - ثلاثا
tr: Allāhumma innī a`ūdhu bi ka min ‘l-fitani mā ẓahara min hā wa mā baṭan.
en: O Allah, I surely seek refuge with you from trials, the apparent of them and the hidden! [3 times]

ar: أَعُوْذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللّٰهِ التَّآمَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ـ ثلاثا
tr: A`ūdhu bi kalimāti ‘lLāhi ‘t-tāmmāti min sharri mā khalaq.
en: I seek refuge with the Complete Words of Allah from evil of what He created. [3 times]
